Research is not independent linguistic, exact-sense CEFR, voice listening, physical iPhone or production evidence.

records.original_english_definition: The person who is speaking or writing.
records.source_supported_observation: British Council explicitly says the personal pronoun I is always capitalised; Cambridge learner's index shows I pronoun A1. The frozen headword i is lowercase while its example correctly writes I.
records.editorial_risk: Display headword I, not i; verify search-key handling and real George/Emma input/listening rather than inferring pronunciation from spelling.

records.original_english_definition: Used before one person or thing when it is not specified.

records.original_english_definition: To become aware of a fact or situation.
records.original_burmese_meaning: သဘောပေါက်သည်
records.original_example_sentence: I didn't realize the door was locked.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford University notes that its -ise house style differs from OUP's Greek-root -ize preference; Cambridge index says UK usually realise and indexes realize verb B1 (BECOME AWARE).
records.editorial_risk: Both realise and realize are valid in British English depending on editorial style; preserve exact sense and obtain independent B1 signoff.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: ဗြိတိသျှအင်္ဂလိပ်တွင် realise ကို မကြာခဏ သုံးသော်လည်း Oxford စာလုံးပေါင်းစနစ်၌ realize လည်း မှန်ကန်သည်။

records.original_english_definition: To identify someone or something because you have seen or known them before.
records.original_burmese_meaning: မှတ်မိသည်၊ ခွဲခြားသိရှိသည်
records.original_example_sentence: I did not recognize the street after the renovation.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford University distinguishes its -ise preference from OUP -ize spelling; recognize is not automatically an American-only error.
records.editorial_risk: Human reviewer should select a consistent UK spelling style; no publisher exact-sense CEFR classification is inferred here.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: recognize နှင့် recognise တို့သည် စာလုံးပေါင်းပုံစံကွဲများဖြစ်ပြီး အသုံးပြုမည့် UK စာလုံးပေါင်းစနစ်ကို တစ်သမတ်တည်း ရွေးရန်လိုသည်။

records.original_english_definition: A building where plays are performed for an audience.
records.original_example_sentence: We booked seats at the theatre for Saturday.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford University UK/US style table distinguishes -re from American -er, including theatre/ theater family.
records.editorial_risk: Keep the British headword theatre unless independently justified; no automatic CEFR inference.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: theatre သည် ဗြိတိသျှစာလုံးပေါင်းဖြစ်ပြီး အမေရိကန်အင်္ဂလိပ်တွင် theater ဟု ရေးလေ့ရှိသည်။

records.original_english_definition: The act of protecting someone or something from attack or harm.

records.original_example_sentence: The walls were built for the defence of the town.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford University UK/US table explicitly gives defence as UK noun and defense as US noun.

records.original_english_definition: The appearance of something caused by how it reflects light.

records.original_english_definition: To motivate people suddenly to take action.
records.original_burmese_meaning: လူများကို ရုတ်တရက် စိတ်အားထက်သန်စေပြီး လှုပ်ရှားဆောင်ရွက်စေသည်
records.original_example_sentence: The flood warnings helped galvanize local volunteers.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford University acknowledges OUP -ize; Cambridge indexed dictionary notes UK usually galvanise and gives a motivation-to-action verb sense.
records.editorial_risk: Do not falsely label galvanize US-only; independently verify C1 exact sense and British George/Emma pronunciation.
records.proposed_myanmar_teaching_note_UNAPPROVE: galvanize နှင့် galvanise တို့သည် စာလုံးပေါင်းကွဲများဖြစ်ပြီး လူများကို လှုပ်ရှားဆောင်ရွက်စေရန် စိတ်အားတက်ကြွစေသည့် အဓိပ္ပာယ်ကို သေချာစစ်ဆေးရန်လိုသည်။

records.original_english_definition: To examine something very carefully to find important details or problems.
records.original_burmese_meaning: အရေးပါသော အသေးစိတ်အချက်များ သို့မဟုတ် ပြဿနာများကို ရှာဖွေရန် သေချာစွာ စစ်ဆေးသည်
records.original_example_sentence: Inspectors scrutinize every safety report before approval.
records.source_supported_observation: Oxford University acknowledges OUP -ize; Cambridge indexed dictionary notes UK usually scrutinise and describes careful examination.
records.editorial_risk: Do not falsely mark scrutinize as American-only; independently verify transitive grammar, C1 sense and final voice audio.
